name: Dressi-AD
definition: A hardware-agnostic automatic differentiation library for differentiable rendering built on Vulkan, using 2D images as primitive data structures instead of multi-dimensional tensors to maintain compatibility with the graphics pipeline.
summary: Dressi-AD is a Vulkan-based automatic differentiation library for differentiable rendering that uses 2D images instead of tensors to integrate reverse-mode AD into graphics pipelines.
